successors.name: Kaqchikel kingdom
successors.text: the Kaqchikel country around Iximche in Chimaltenango Department; the pages give no frontier

successors.name: Spanish Empire
successors.text: The K'iche' lands after the 1470 break, without the Kaqchikel country (Chimaltenango)

ledger.x: c. 1225: the K'iche' found their kingdom at Jakawitz in the Chujuyup valley under B'alam Kitze.
c. 1400: under Q'uq'kumatz the Nima K'iche lineage leaves Pismachi and settles Q'umarkaj. The page gives Q'uq'kumatz's reign as 1400-1435 and no year for the move.

c. 1435-1475: K'iq'ab's conquests: 'the K'iche' kingdom expanded to include Rabinal, Coban, and Quetzaltenango', west to the Okos River, east to the Motagua and south to Escuintla with Kaqchikel help, and Mam lands near Zaculeu and the Sacapulas area. The page gives no years; the event sits at the start of the reign…
1470: 'a rebellion shook Q'umarkaj'; the K'iche' lords turned on their Kaqchikel allies, who fled and founded Iximche.
1475: 'After the death of king K'iq'ab in 1475 the K'iche' were engaged in warfare' with the Tz'utujil and the Kaqchikel; the page names an attempt to surprise Iximche under Tepepul.
1510: 'Aztec emissaries from Moctezuma II arrived in Q'umarkaj to request tribute' and the K'iche' accepted vassalage.
1521: the Aztec tributary tie ends with the fall of Tenochtitlan.
1522: 'a peace accord was made' between the K'iche' and the Kaqchikel after the wars that followed K'iq'ab's death.

February 1524: Alvarado fights the K'iche' at Xetulul on 8 February, in the pass on 12 February and in the Quetzaltenango valley on 18 February 1524 ('a K'iche' army confronted the Spanish army in the Quetzaltenango valley').
March 1524: Alvarado is 'invited... to Q'umarkaj on 7 March 1524', seizes the lords and burns them; the battles are over.
March 1524: Q'umarkaj 'was razed and levelled'; the K'iche' kingdom passes to Spanish rule (Alvarado entered Q'umarkaj in March 1524).
March 1524: the K'iche' kingdom ends with the burning of Q'umarkaj; its remnant moved to Santa Cruz del Quiche.

wars.name: K'iche'-Kaqchikel and Tz'utujil wars
wars.outcome: 'The K'iche' fought the Tz'utujil and Kaqchikel' after 1475; the Kaqchikel defeated them around 1491 (Iximche page); 'in 1522 a peace accord was made'.

wars.name: Spanish conquest of Guatemala
wars.outcome: Alvarado's 8, 12 and 18 February 1524 battles and the burning of Q'umarkaj in March ended the K'iche' kingdom; the conquest as a whole ran to 1697 (Petén).

certainty.note: No frontier is described on the pages; shapes are department-level readings.
